items.title: PLAN：精确分类 321 候选为 in-scope（该清）/ documented-exception（该留），产出白名单
items.context: 对 packages/scripts/docs 逐文件判定：koala 品牌/散文=该清；.koala 运行时路径、盐值、decisions 历史、测试断言意图、CHANGELOG=该留。白名单写入 plan.md 与 understanding。

happy.desc: PLAN artifact: plan.md and understanding contain classification of all 321 candidates into in-scope vs documented-exception categories; WHY: pure planning output, verified by artifact existence and completeness, not auto-testable code behavior

edge.desc: Classification whitelist correctly handles a boundary line containing BOTH a neutral process-lane token (e.g. koala-codex) AND real koala brand prose on the same line -> the line is still classified as in-scope (should-change) because the brand word remains after neutral-token stripping; WHY: prevents the classifier from under-counting lines that mix legitimate exceptions with actual brand text

A line containing only .koala runtime path (e.g. ~/.koala/activity.json) is classified as documented-exception (should-keep) -> not included in the 255 true-brand count; WHY: ensures runtime path boundary is correctly drawn at classification time

adversarial.desc: Feed the classifier a line with bare koala brand prose and no neutral token pattern (e.g. a comment saying koala workflow engine) -> line is NOT silently whitelisted, appears in the in-scope should-change set; WHY: catches under-counting bugs where the whitelist is too broad and swallows actual brand text that should be cleaned

Feed the classifier a line that contains koala inside a longer unrelated word (e.g. KoalaFoo) that does not match any neutral pattern -> line is classified as in-scope; WHY: ensures substring/regex patterns do not accidentally exempt novel koala-containing identifiers

happy.desc: git grep -i koala-lab packages/lab/src/ returns zero unclassified hits after cleanup -> all koala-lab brand references in lab core/handlers/tool-defs/profiles replaced with lattice-lab; WHY: confirms primary brand rename completed
npm run build succeeds after lab brand rename -> no broken imports or string references; WHY: ensures rename did not introduce compile errors

edge.desc: git grep -i koala packages/lab/src/core/config.ts shows only B-ed70-owned .Codex line untouched -> coordination boundary respected; WHY: ensures this story does not conflict with concurrent B-ed70 changes
git grep -i koala packages/lab/package.json shows only B-ed70-owned description field untouched -> coordination boundary respected; WHY: verifies cross-story conflict avoidance

adversarial.desc: Introduce a new koala-lab string in a lab profile comment, re-run branding smoke -> smoke detects the regression; WHY: confirms guard test catches re-introduction of cleaned brand

happy.desc: git grep -i koala packages/main/src/ piped through cli-engine-branding-smoke isClassified filter returns zero unclassified lines -> all brand comments and CLI text cleaned; WHY: confirms main package source is brand-free except documented exceptions
npm run build succeeds after main source brand cleanup -> no compile errors from string/comment changes; WHY: build integrity after refactor

edge.desc: git grep -i koala packages/main/src/ still matches .koala runtime path references (e.g. ~/.koala/) -> runtime paths preserved as documented exceptions; WHY: ensures legitimate runtime paths not accidentally removed

git grep -i koala packages/main/src/ still matches LEGACY_KOALA* constants and koala-*-integrity-v1 salt strings -> salt values and legacy constants preserved; WHY: ensures security-critical salts and backward compat constants untouched
git grep koala-codex packages/main/src/ returns expected process-lane references intact -> process lane names preserved; WHY: ensures koala-codex/koala-review* lane names are documented exceptions

Rename a .koala runtime path reference to .lattice in main/src, run e2e tests -> tests fail due to broken path; WHY: confirms that over-aggressive cleanup breaks runtime and tests catch it

node scripts/verify-fail-fast-health.mjs executes without error after cleanup -> script functionality preserved; WHY: ensures comment-only changes did not corrupt script logic

items.title: 处理测试 smoke/fixtures 的 koala：改非意图夹具、保留测试断言意图
items.context: 37 个 koala.config.json fixture + smoke 测试：lattice-only-absence-smoke、cli-engine-branding-smoke 等故意断言 koala 被忽略/识别的保留；纯历史/无意图夹具按需改。逐个判定。

happy.desc: npm run test:e2e passes including cli-engine-branding-smoke and lattice-only-absence-smoke -> intentional test assertions preserved and still pass; WHY: confirms test intent not broken by fixture changes

git grep -i koala packages/main/src/tasks/cli-engine-branding-smoke.ts shows only classified references (process lanes, LEGACY_KOALA, salt, .koala paths) -> branding smoke test preserved as documented exception; WHY: smoke test itself is a legitimate koala-mentioning file

edge.desc: git grep -i koala packages/main/src/tasks/lattice-only-absence-smoke.ts shows only classified assertion references -> absence smoke test preserved as documented exception; WHY: this test intentionally references koala to assert it is absent from certain contexts

Non-intentional koala.config.json fixture files renamed/updated to lattice.config.json where they were pure historical artifacts -> git grep koala.config.json returns only files where fixture name is part of test assertion logic; WHY: distinguishes fixture-by-intent from fixture-by-accident

adversarial.desc: Delete a koala reference from cli-engine-branding-smoke.ts NEUTRAL_TOKEN_PATTERNS, run branding smoke -> smoke fails because it can no longer classify legitimate legacy tokens; WHY: ensures the classification rules themselves are not accidentally narrowed during cleanup

Rename a koala.config.json fixture that IS used by test assertion logic, run affected test suite -> test fails with missing fixture; WHY: catches over-aggressive fixture rename that breaks test expectations

items.title: 验收 gate：git grep -i koala 在 active 范围只剩 documented-exceptions 白名单
items.context: 跑 git grep -i koala 排除白名单，断言为空；lattice validate 全绿；build + e2e 通过。

happy.desc: git grep -i koala over active scope (packages/ scripts/ docs/ CLAUDE.md) filtered by documented-exception whitelist (process lanes, .koala paths, salts, LEGACY_KOALA*, test assertion intent, decisions history, CHANGELOG) returns zero unclassified lines -> acceptance gate passes; WHY: primary acceptance criterion for the entire story
lattice validate succeeds with zero errors -> story metadata and checklist are consistent; WHY: Lattice workflow gate
npm run build succeeds -> no compile errors from all brand changes across packages; WHY: build integrity gate
npm run test:e2e succeeds -> all existing tests including branding smokes pass; WHY: regression gate

edge.desc: git grep -i koala over CHANGELOG.md and docs/requirements/decisions/ returns results but all are excluded from active scope -> historical documents correctly excluded from sweep; WHY: ensures history preservation boundary is respected

git grep -i koala over .lattice/ story metadata returns results but all are excluded from active scope -> story metadata not accidentally cleaned; WHY: .lattice/ is workflow metadata, not active source

adversarial.desc: Add a new file with unclassified koala brand text in packages/main/src/, re-run acceptance gate grep -> gate correctly reports the new file as unclassified; WHY: confirms the gate is not silently over-filtering and would catch future regressions

Add koala text that matches a documented-exception pattern (e.g. koala-codex) but in a context where it is actually brand text not a process lane, run gate -> gate must still classify it as neutral (known limitation) or detect it; WHY: stress-tests the classification boundary between legitimate exception patterns and brand text that happens to match patterns
